title: GM C10 / K10 / Blazer 6-Lug Wilwood Forged Dynalite Rear Parking Brake Kit
description:
Upgrade the rear stopping power on your classic GM truck or SUV with the Wilwood Forged Dynalite Rear Parking Brake Kit (140-18158-D). Engineered specifically for Chevy C10 / K10, GMC K1500, and 1971–1991 GM Fullsize 4WD Blazers/Jimmys running a 6x5.5" bolt pattern and 2.46" axle offset, this kit delivers modern 4-piston performance while maintaining an internal drum-in-hat parking brake assembly.

Featuring 4-piston Dynalite calipers, 12.19" x 0.81" drilled and slotted SRP iron rotors, and an internal shoe mechanism, this kit provides a clean setup without bulky external mechanical levers hanging off the caliper.

#### What’s Included:

* Forged Dynalite 4-Piston Calipers: Finished in durable black powder coat with stainless steel pistons.
* 12.19" x 0.81" SRP Rotors: Vented, cross-drilled, and slotted iron rotors with a black e-coat finish to inhibit corrosion on non-friction surfaces.
* Internal Drum-in-Hat Parking Brake Mechanism: Tightly integrated shoe system housed inside the rotor hat for dependable static holding power.
* BP-10 Smart Pads & Hardware: Street-performance friction pads, axle mounting brackets, and grade-8 installation hardware.

#### Key Specs & Notes:

* Axle Fitment: Fits Large Chevy C10 / K10 rear end flanges (6x5.5" bolt pattern) with a 2.46" axle offset.
* Wheel Clearance: Fits most popular 15" and larger rear wheels (verify inner barrel clearance prior to mounting).
* Brake Lines & Parking Cables Required: Flexlines and parking brake cables are not included in this core kit. Requires stainless flexlines with -3AN fittings (Wilwood P/N 220-17288 or 220-17289) and extended parking brake cables (Wilwood P/N 330-9371).

#### Vehicle / Axle Application:

* 1971–1991 Chevrolet K5 Blazer / GMC Jimmy (4WD models)
* 1975–1986 Chevrolet K10 / GMC K1500 Pickup Trucks (4WD 6-Lug)
* 1975–1985 Chevrolet / GMC Suburban K10 / K1500 (4WD 6-Lug)
